item.title: Tottori Sand Museum: Sculptures Carved from Sand — Guide
item.description: The Sand Museum, right beside the Tottori Sand Dunes, is the only museum in the world devoted to sculpture made from sand. Each year it invites top sand sculptors from around the globe to carve enormous, astonishingly detailed works — figures, buildings and scenes several metres tall — around a single theme, such as a different country or civilisation. The results, held together only by water and packing, are displayed for about a year before being returned to loose sand and rebuilt anew for the next theme.
